item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem:
Anaya's class will watch a solar eclipse. Someone suggests looking straight at the Sun when most of it is covered, or using a hand mirror to watch the Sun's reflection.

Which claim about safety is correct?

options.A: It is unsafe to look directly at the Sun during the eclipse without proper protection.
options.B: Looking into a hand mirror that reflects the Sun is a safe substitute for proper protection.
options.C: When only a thin crescent of the Sun remains, it is safe to look directly without protection.
options.D: Watching a carefully projected image of the Sun on a classroom screen without eclipse glasses is still unsafe.
